cases.name: finds every executable match, in PATH order
cases.setup: mkdir a b c; printf '#!/bin/sh\n' > a/tool; chmod +x a/tool; printf x > b/tool; chmod -x b/tool; printf '#!/bin/sh\n' > c/tool; chmod +x c/tool

cases.name: exit status 0 when found
cases.setup: mkdir a; printf '#!/bin/sh\n' > a/tool; chmod +x a/tool

cases.name: a non-executable file does not count
cases.setup: mkdir a; printf x > a/tool; chmod -x a/tool

cases.name: the same name in a later directory is still found
cases.setup: mkdir a b; printf '#!/bin/sh\n' > b/tool; chmod +x b/tool
